subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should this dashboard A2UI bridge wait for the canonical browser action-ingress work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497, or should dashboard define its own action bridge contract?
rationale: The choice affects product sequencing and a browser-to-Gateway security boundary, and cleanup automation cannot safely pick the permanent contract.

options.title: Sequence after Canvas ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open as the dashboard child and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the browser action sink before dashboard adapts it.

options.title: Design dashboard bridge now
options.body: Let the dashboard work define the action bridge directly, but require an explicit security review and tests so it does not drift from Canvas.

options.title: Move outward to plugin API
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core focused on generic plugin/API seams and ask the A2UI dashboard adapter to ship as an external plugin once required APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Sequence after Canvas ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the dashboard child and require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the browser action sink before dashboard adapts it.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-main signal around the plugin-tab precedent and Canvas surface history, making them a good routing owner for the product/security choice.
